issue.title: bob-cli cargo test has 22 failures on clean master (bob-obsidian lib + cli integration)
issue.description:
## Report

Proposed by sase-1v7.5 (bob-cli adopts the on-demand decisions roster, epic sase-1v7) as
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1; triaged by the sase-1v7 land agent.

bob-cli `just check` (cargo test) reported 22 failures that the phase agent reproduced
identically on the clean bob-cli base before its docs-only memory commit `d13f8d1d`
(base `9dd67c62`). The phase changed only `sase/memory/**`, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md, so
the failures are not caused by epic sase-1v7.

Failing tests named by the phase agent:

- bob-obsidian lib (4): `three_component_marker_keeps_route_and_task_contexts`,
  `task_drawers` `resolve_for_merge`, `wispr_summary` `stable_words`,
  `september_shaped_vault_finishes_fast`
- cli integration (18), including the `inbox_route`, `note_pull`, and
  `project_note_offer` suites

The land agent did not rerun the suite: the bob-cli checkout had no built `target/`, and
a cold Rust build was out of scope for the landing. Start by running
`cargo test -p bob-obsidian` and the cli integration tests on current bob-cli master,
then split each distinct root cause into its own `ci` (or `flake`, if a rerun passes)
task.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The sase-1v7.5 phase agent reproduced the same 22 failures identically on the clean bob-cli base 9dd67c62 and again after its docs-only change, so they are deterministic and pre-existing.
